product_metadata.title: Sticky Toffee Oven Mitts and Pot Holders Set of 9 with Kitchen Towels and Dishcloths, Oeko-Tex Cotton Terry Kitchen Dish Towels & Dish Cloths, Non-Slip Silicone Oven Mitt Set, Dark Blue
features: SET OF NINE VALUE PACK: Collection includes 2 terry kitchen towels (28 in x 16 in), 4 terry dishcloths (12 in x 12 in), 2 pot holders (7 in x 9 in) and 1 oven mitt (12.5 in x 7 in). Available in a variety of rich colors to coordinate with any kitchen décor.

ABSORBENT and DURABLE: 100% Oeko-Tex certified cotton kitchen towels and dishcloths have a durable popcorn terry texture, making them highly absorbent and long-lasting. They're great for wiping up spills and drying dishes, yet soft enough for drying hands.

NON-SLIP GRIP & HANGING LOOP: The printed silicone design on the oven mitt and hot pads provides a secure non-slip grip while handling pots and pans. It is rated to withstand up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit for your safety and ease of use. The oven mitt and pot holders are perfectly designed with a loop for easy hanging.

CARE FOR YOUR KITCHEN LINEN SET: Towels and dishcloths are machine washable and dryer safe; oven mitt and pot holders are machine washable and lay flat to dry. Our towels withstand repeated uses and washes and are a sustainable alternative to paper towels.
GIFT: Decorated with charming, chic packaging, this 9 piece kitchen towel, oven mitt and pot holder set makes a great hostess, wedding, birthday, college, apartment essentials or housewarming gift.
